title: This Frog Freezes Solid, Stops Its Heart, Then Hops Away

scenes.text: This frog freezes solid and comes back to life.
When winter hits, the wood frog's heart stops beating.
Its breathing stops too, and up to 65 percent of its body water turns to ice.
Sugar from its liver floods its cells and protects them from the ice.
It can stay frozen for months, then thaw in spring.
Its heart restarts, and within hours it hops away.

description:
The wood frog freezes solid in winter. Its heart and breathing stop, and up to 65 percent of its body water turns to ice.
In spring it thaws and hops away.
Would you believe it if you did not see it?
first_comment: Would you survive being frozen if you could? Or is that the wood frog's secret?
